mapper.select: SELECT f.facility_id AS facilityId ,f.name AS name ,f.address AS address ,f.concurrent_match_limit AS concurrentMatchLimit ,f.status AS status ,(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(s.name ORDER BY fs.sport_id SEPARATOR ', ') FROM facility_sport fs JOIN sport s ON fs.sport_id = s.sport_id WHERE fs.facility_id = f.facility_id) AS sportsLabel FROM facility f JOIN facility_manager fm ON fm.facility_id = f.facility_id WHERE fm.user_id = #{userId} AND f.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY f.facility_id ASC
